Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: TRANSPARENT GAME SPRITE ATLAS. Supporting identity reference image is the approved Robot Pulse app icon. Robot Pulse approved mobile game style: premium illustrated 3D hard-surface cyan and titanium armor, dark midnight navy inset panels, sharp chamfered/octagonal corners, restrained electric cyan edge lights, amber utility lights and warm gold primary buttons, readable broad shapes, brushed metal rather than plastic, consistent light from upper left. No unrelated fantasy ornaments. No watermark.
Generate one square high-resolution sheet, 3 columns by 3 rows, exactly NINE separate complete robot sprites, aligned to an evenly spaced grid. Transparent background with generous clear gutters, no text, no numbers, no frames, no pedestal, no title, no ground planes or baked floor shadows. Each sprite centered inside its own cell. No overlap.
Every robot is the SAME approved character: squat friendly octagonal armored body, black glass face and two warm rectangular eyes where visible, tiny amber beacon on the left shoulder. Simple recognizable cyan/titanium armor with a short forearm-mounted cannon on the robot's right side (viewer left in front view). Cannon sits at body/arm height pointing forward, NEVER mounted on roof, NO camera, NO lens on roof, NO turret. Keep compact and easy to animate as a 2D sprite.
Column1 cyan armor, column2 violet armor, column3 amber-gold armor. Only armor color changes across columns.
Row1: front three-quarter gameplay queue view, complete small robot body with short feet and same arm cannon, crisp face.
Row2: strict overhead orthographic camera looking straight down; robot facing UP on the page; visible octagonal cyan/purple/gold roof shell and symmetrical compact shoulders, small amber beacon, short arm cannon extends forward (UP) beside shell. Do not invent a face looking upward; preserve plausible overhead geometry. These are the actual conveyor sprites.
Row3: the identical overhead sprites facing UP, in firing recoil pose with a SMALL tight white-cyan/violet/gold muzzle flash at tip of same cannon. No long beam or floor. Same size and pivot as row2.
All nine sprites have consistent scale within row, clean silhouette, sharply rendered materials readable at 64px, restrained glow inside their cells. Actual alpha transparency, not checkerboard.

Use case: background-extraction. Edit target is the entire provided game UI atlas. Remove ONLY ALL the gray-blue background and all diffuse floor shadows BETWEEN the twelve interface components and around the outside edges. Keep the exact twelve objects, their positions, their internal opaque dark/gold/cyan surfaces, colors and details. True alpha 0 in all gaps, no residual gray fog or background haze. Don't remove dark interiors of components. Every component must remain an independent complete cutout. No checkerboard pattern, no text. High-quality clean alpha edges, keep original canvas aspect ratio and exact composition.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game ICON ATLAS with ACTUAL TRANSPARENT background. Reference supplies Robot Pulse aesthetic only. Robot Pulse approved mobile game style: premium illustrated 3D hard-surface cyan and titanium armor, dark midnight navy inset panels, sharp chamfered/octagonal corners, restrained electric cyan edge lights, amber utility lights and warm gold primary buttons, readable broad shapes, brushed metal rather than plastic, consistent light from upper left. No unrelated fantasy ornaments. No watermark.
One square high-resolution sheet, EXACTLY 16 isolated icons in a regular 4x4 grid. Generous transparent gutters, every icon wholly inside its cell, no words, digits, captions, button circles, boxes or backgrounds.
Row1 left to right: EXTRA WAITING TRAY icon (small top-down empty square tray with strong plus sign); robot hand with index fingertip SELECT gesture; TWO CURVED ARROWS forming clear shuffle symbol; solid silver PADLOCK.
Row2: white-silver GEAR; silver SPEAKER with sound waves; silver MUSICAL NOTE; simple silver GLOBE meridians.
Row3: beveled left-pointing BACK CHEVRON; two white PAUSE bars; cyan triangular PLAY symbol pointing right; white beveled CLOSE X.
Row4: gold TROPHY; a single gold COIN with tiny engraved pulse zigzag; gold five-point STAR; small cyan metallic REWARD CHEST.
Each icon rendered as concise polished hard-surface 3D metal, clean recognizable at 40px, restrained lights and shadows within silhouette. White/silver utility icons with cyan highlights; gold trophy/coin/star. No additional ornament, no excessive bloom, no text. Actual alpha transparency between all sixteen icons.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square production gameplay ARENA PLATE. Use reference's exact arena industrial look but isolate just its arena. Robot Pulse approved mobile game style: premium illustrated 3D hard-surface cyan and titanium armor, dark midnight navy inset panels, sharp chamfered/octagonal corners, restrained electric cyan edge lights, amber utility lights and warm gold primary buttons, readable broad shapes, brushed metal rather than plastic, consistent light from upper left. No unrelated fantasy ornaments. No watermark.
One square large top-down board assembly centered on ACTUAL TRANSPARENT exterior. Full arena frame entirely in canvas with 5% clear margins. Outer octagonal/chamfered square titanium rim with electric cyan light strips and four circular corner bearings. Inside it is one continuous broad DARK EMPTY conveyor lane around four sides, smooth chamfered corners. Inner playing field is solid very dark navy flat inset with subtle metal texture, NO grid (grid is code).
CRITICAL no arrows, no chevrons, no robots, no tiles, no text, no numbers, no digits, no HUD, no extra controls, no background scene. The lane must be completely blank because moving directional arrows and robots will be drawn in code. Clear distinction between rim, lane and inner playfield; interior opaque navy, exterior transparent. Straight-on exact overhead camera, square not perspective, usable directly under a Canvas game. High-quality material detail matching reference, but calm unobstructed central field.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: reusable game MODAL FRAME ATLAS with TRUE TRANSPARENT exterior. Robot Pulse approved mobile game style: premium illustrated 3D hard-surface cyan and titanium armor, dark midnight navy inset panels, sharp chamfered/octagonal corners, restrained electric cyan edge lights, amber utility lights and warm gold primary buttons, readable broad shapes, brushed metal rather than plastic, consistent light from upper left. No unrelated fantasy ornaments. No watermark.
Make a high-resolution wide landscape sheet with exactly THREE large separate empty vertical dialog panels side by side. Each panel has a sharp chamfered titanium outer frame, fine cyan neon inner rim, solid opaque midnight navy center, integrated EMPTY chamfered header plaque and blank roomy content area. Left panel compact with cyan accents for information and purchases; middle panel taller with cyan accents for settings and pause; right panel with restrained amber/gold accents for rewards/victory. Panels are matching family at same width, differing slightly in height. Each fully within own third of the image with large transparent gaps. Each has a small empty square socket at top right for the separate close icon. No text, no digits, no icons, no buttons or illustrations in content areas. All interiors opaque dark navy. Exterior and gaps exactly transparent, no fog, no backdrop, no checkerboard. Straight-on orthographic 2D interface assets, not tilted floating holograms. Details concentrated on edges to allow nine-slice scaling later.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game tile and effects sprite atlas. One high-resolution landscape sheet on true transparent background, regular 4 COLUMNS by 3 ROWS, twelve separate assets, spacious clear gaps.
Each row is one color: top CYAN, middle VIOLET, bottom AMBER GOLD. All columns follow identical design and size.
Column1: ONE perfectly square top-down pixel block with beveled edges, polished metal/crystal face, small subtle diamond center, all four sides equal, no perspective tilt.
Column2: one SHORT vertical upward-pointing energy projectile, bright core and soft colored edge, compact with transparent exterior.
Column3: one SMALL four-point muzzle flash with luminous center, entirely within its cell.
Column4: impact burst of about six tiny square pixel fragments around a soft small spark, compact, not a large explosion.
No labels, words, numbers, borders, floor or canvas background. Actual alpha transparency between assets and around glows. Clean independent elements usable in Canvas, consistent upper-left lighting on tiles, restrained glow on effects.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: portrait mobile game BACKGROUND ONLY. Reference is style guidance. Generate one tall 1:2 portrait futuristic hangar interior background matching Robot Pulse. Dark midnight blue metal architecture at left and right, a few integrated vertical cyan light strips and tiny amber utility lights, perspective metal floor in lower quarter, distant industrial depth. Center 80% mostly dark calm navy negative space for overlaying game interface. No giant bright central feature. No text, logo, robot, board, controls, buttons, panels, tiles, icons or grids. Fully opaque background suitable for full-bleed mobile image. Keep atmosphere restrained and readable, not a battlefield or plastic toy room. All meaningful game content will be separate overlays.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: complementary HUD states atlas on ACTUAL TRANSPARENT background. No unrelated fantasy ornaments. No watermark.
High-resolution square sheet of EIGHT separate empty UI components in exactly 2 COLUMNS and 4 ROWS. Large transparent gutters. No text, digits, labels, characters or backdrop anywhere.
Row1: two identical SIMPLE HORIZONTAL battery shells with wide uncluttered central face for a big number to be overlaid: left fully filled cyan; right almost empty dark navy with one small cyan bar at left. Small terminal at right, light titanium rim, no multiple confusing segments.
Row2: two identical pill-shaped futuristic metallic toggle switches: left cyan ON knob positioned at right; right muted navy OFF knob positioned at left. No words.
Row3: two identical rectangular chamfered selection tabs: left selected cyan luminous center; right unselected navy center. Empty wide label-safe surfaces.
Row4: left wide empty chamfered level-title plaque, dark navy center cyan titanium border; right shorter empty matching section-header plaque.
All assets front-on, consistent metal materials and light, no tilt or scene. Outside components and all gaps have alpha0, no fake checkerboard, no fog or floor shadows. All eight components clearly separated and uncut, sized for direct reuse in mobile game UI.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit IMAGE1 settings screen. Reference IMAGE2 right panel has required horizontal battery design. Keep the complete settings frame, all text LANGUAGE EN ES SOUND ON MUSIC ON ENERGY MAX CLOSE, all controls and spacing. Change ONLY the energy row icon/status: replace tall vertical cylindrical battery at left and separate number at right with ONE SIMPLE HORIZONTAL CYAN BATTERY containing a big clear white "5", with "MAX" beside it. Keep ENERGY label readable. Match horizontal battery shape from image2, with simpler broad central number area. Also make background behind dialog uniformly blurred dark navy hangar architecture, removing any humanoid/soldier silhouettes. No other changes. Same high quality portrait, full frame and buttons visible, no crop.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target IMAGE1; image2 reference ONLY for the central pixel mosaic. Make exactly TWO local corrections to IMAGE1 and keep EVERYTHING ELSE identical including all NINE robot characters in three rows, booster footer, five bays, track, arrows, whole layout, dimensions, lighting and materials.
CHANGE1: inside the central square arena, DELETE the scattered small robot-face symbols/icons. Replace them with ONE COHERENT LARGE ROBOT-FACE SILHOUETTE BUILT FROM MANY SMALL SOLID SQUARE PIXEL BLOCKS, like the central mosaic in image2. This is a destructible pixel puzzle, not a match-three icon grid! Cyan blocks form an octagonal head and chin, four amber blocks form two eyes, a few violet blocks form an antenna and side details. Each small block is a single solid colored beveled square with only a tiny center diamond, NO faces, NO pictograms or outlines within individual tiles. Dark empty squares surround this simple recognizable robot face. About 35-45 small blocks total, not a dense difficult level. Cyan projectile from bottom robot points at nearest cyan block.
CHANGE2: simplify top battery HUD to ONE horizontal cyan battery shell with a large white 5 INSIDE it, followed by MAX. Remove lightning bolt symbol and separate 5 outside battery. Keep coin count200.
Preserve all THREE ROWS of THREE robots below exactly; do not remove any row. Keep all four arrow directions exactly as currently shown (bottomright/rightup/topleft/leftdown). No other changes. High-quality crisp complete portrait UI.
